verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party organizations, memberships, or org-scoped invitation feature in Supabase Auth. What it does show are developer building blocks: linking auth data to your own tables via triggers and foreign keys, RLS row-level scoping, and custom access token claims. The user-level invite path ("only way to create new users is through invites") is an adjacent account-creation control, not a B2B org invitation flow, so none of this earns credit for an out-of-the-box multi-tenant org model.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations, memberships, and invitation flows out of the box
